id: 13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course
title: 低温液体：冷得伤人
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course/src.py

points.K11: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
points.K18: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
points.K20: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一只冒白雾的不锈钢低温容器旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a stainless steel cryogenic container with white vapor drifting from its opening and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊低温液体，冷得会伤人。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着运动鞋，伸出光手想去摸结霜的管道
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in mesh sneakers reaches a bare hand toward a frosted metal pipe on a cryogenic tank.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇，想摸摸结霜的管子。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意他停下，指向防护用品架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to stop him and points to a shelf of protective gear.
shots.narration: 小研叫住他：先弄懂低温液体。

shots.scene: 压缩气瓶图标旁边，多出一个带雪花的低温容器图标
shots.prompt_en: A compressed gas cylinder icon with a separate snowflake-marked cryogenic container icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 说到压缩气体，低温液体单算一类。

shots.scene: 低温容器图标周围有一圈专属的警示和防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A cryogenic container icon surrounded by its own ring of warning and protection icons. No people.
shots.narration: 它有自己的危害，也有自己的防范。

shots.scene: 结霜的圆筒容器，温度计指向极低刻度
shots.prompt_en: A frost-covered cylindrical container next to a thermometer icon pointing to an extremely low mark. No people.
shots.narration: 它冷到极点，常温下本该是气体。

shots.scene: 蓝光下开口容器里白雾翻涌
shots.prompt_en: Thick white vapor churning out of an open container under cool blue light. No people.
shots.narration: 离开低温放在室温，就会剧烈沸腾。

shots.scene: 雪花图标落到手形图标上，指尖变白发紫
shots.prompt_en: A snowflake icon landing on a hand icon whose fingertips turn pale and purple. No people.
shots.narration: 直接碰到，皮肤会冷灼伤甚至冻伤。

shots.scene: 冒雾的不锈钢容器外壁和管道
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the outer wall and pipes of a stainless steel container with cold vapor curling around them. No people.
shots.narration: 装低温液体的容器和管道也危险。

shots.scene: 插画：冬天雪地里，舌头粘在冰冷铁杆上的卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple illustration icon of a tongue stuck to an icy metal pole in a snowy winter scene. No people.
shots.narration: 冰冷表面会粘住皮肤，像舔冬天铁杆。

shots.scene: 液体从管口倒入容器，白雾翻腾，液滴飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Cold liquid pouring from a hose end into a container, white vapor billowing and droplets splashing out. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进较热的容器，会沸腾飞溅，

shots.scene: 戴手套的手揭开蓝色杜瓦瓶盖，白雾涌出
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand lifting the lid of a blue dewar as white vapor rushes out.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾到的风险也随之增加。

shots.scene: 容器开口处凝出冰霜，慢慢堵住
shots.prompt_en: Frost condensing around a container opening and slowly forming an ice plug. No people.
shots.narration: 开口处会冷凝，再次冻结。

shots.scene: 结霜的罐盖提手，压力表指针升到红区
shots.prompt_en: A frosted lid handle on a tank beside a pressure gauge whose needle climbs into the red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 开口一堵，压力积聚，可能爆炸。

shots.scene: 液氧容器图标旁，木块和布料图标猛烈燃烧
shots.prompt_en: A liquid oxygen container icon next to a wood block icon and a cloth icon burning fiercely. No people.
shots.narration: 液氧极危险，让东西更易燃甚至爆炸。

shots.scene: 小研从小杜瓦瓶往开口容器里倒液氮，白雾翻腾、液体溅出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours liquid nitrogen from a small dewar into an open container, vapor billowing and some liquid splashing.
shots.narration: 安全使用，有一套步骤。

shots.scene: 排风扇转动，墙上氧含量报警器亮绿灯
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan spinning and an oxygen sensor alarm glowing green on the wall of a cryogenic room. No people.
shots.narration: 通风很重要，建议装氧含量报警器。

shots.scene: 小研在使用前和使用中查看报警器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the oxygen alarm display before starting, then again during work.
shots.narration: 用前用中都要经常检查。

shots.scene: 穿实验服的老周从液氮罐里提出提筒，罐口干净
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat lifts a canister out of a clean liquid nitrogen tank.
shots.narration: 所有设备都不能沾油脂、油污和灰尘，

shots.scene: 油滴和灰尘图标靠近液氧容器，冒出火星
shots.prompt_en: Oil drop and dust icons near a liquid oxygen container giving off sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 它们会和液氧等低温液体起反应。

shots.scene: 阿杰徒手拿钳子，在冒雾的不锈钢盆里夹东西
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, bare-handed, uses metal tongs to pick items out of a steaming stainless steel basin.
shots.narration: 低温会改变材料的性能，

shots.scene: 普通材料遇冷碎裂的图标，旁边耐低温材料打勾
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary material icon cracking apart in the cold, next to a cryogenic-rated material icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 让它变脆，所以必须选对材料。

shots.section_title: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
shots.scene: 杜瓦瓶剖面图：内胆、真空夹层、外壁
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a dewar showing the inner vessel, the vacuum layer and the outer wall. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体存放在专用杜瓦瓶里，
overlay: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖

shots.section_title: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
shots.scene: 容器内白雾翻腾，夹层标出真空
shots.prompt_en: Vapor swirling inside the dewar while the vacuum gap between liquid and outer wall is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 液体和外壁之间隔着真空夹层。

shots.section_title: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
shots.scene: 杜瓦瓶的泄压阀和松松盖着的盖子，气体逸出
shots.prompt_en: A dewar with a pressure relief valve and a loose-fitting lid letting vapor escape. No people.
shots.narration: 必须有泄压阀和松盖，防止憋压。

shots.scene: 走廊里，老李和老周一起推带轮的大液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: In a corridor, the facility engineer and the older man move a large wheeled liquid nitrogen tank together.
shots.narration: 搬运低温液体容器，至少两个人。

shots.scene: 结霜的泡沫盖，水滴图标进入罐口结成冰
shots.prompt_en: A frosted foam lid with a water droplet icon entering the opening and turning into ice. No people.
shots.narration: 别让水汽进入容器，

shots.scene: 冰块堵住泄压阀的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an ice plug blocking a dewar's pressure relief valve. No people.
shots.narration: 结了冰，会把泄压阀堵死。

shots.scene: 电炉、暖气片图标远离低温容器，中间有距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate icon and a radiator icon set far from a cryogenic container with a distance arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 热源要远离低温液体。

shots.scene: 老李穿反光工作服、戴长手套，在槽车旁连接软管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a reflective work suit and long black gloves connects a hose beside a cryogenic tanker truck, traffic cones nearby.
shots.narration: 操作低温液体，始终穿戴合适防护。

shots.scene: 戴蓝色宽松低温手套的双手在白雾中，一抖就脱下
shots.prompt_en: Hands in loose blue cryogenic gloves in white vapor, one glove slipping off easily with a shake.
shots.narration: 手套要宽松，溅进液体能马上甩掉。

shots.scene: 皮手套和低温手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: A leather glove icon and a cryogenic glove icon, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 选皮革手套或低温专用手套。

shots.scene: 挂着的黄色橡胶手套被打叉，旁边一只变硬开裂
shots.prompt_en: Yellow rubber gloves hanging on a rack, crossed out, with one shown stiff and cracked by cold. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用橡胶手套，遇冷会变硬。

shots.scene: 小研调整贴合脸部的护目镜，再戴上面罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts close-fitting goggles, then lowers a face shield over them.
shots.narration: 面罩和护目镜护住眼睛和面部。

shots.scene: 护目镜边缘紧贴皮肤的特写示意
shots.prompt_en: A close diagram of goggle edges sealing tightly against the skin. No people.
shots.narration: 要紧贴皮肤，防止液体渗进去。

shots.section_title: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
shots.scene: 老李穿封闭皮鞋，液滴从鞋面滚落
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in closed leather shoes stands on a wet floor holding a hose, droplets rolling off the leather.
shots.narration: 穿封闭式皮鞋，皮革能挡住液体。
overlay: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋

shots.section_title: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
shots.scene: 网面运动鞋吸入液体被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mesh sneaker icon soaking up liquid toward the foot, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 运动鞋会把液体吸向皮肤。

shots.section_title: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
shots.scene: 皮围裙系在实验服外面
shots.prompt_en: A leather apron tied over a lab coat on a hook. No people.
shots.narration: 同样道理，衣服外加一条皮围裙。

shots.scene: 戒指和手表图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A ring icon and a wristwatch icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时不戴戒指、手表等金属饰物。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 双手放在冒雾的盆边
shots.prompt_en: Two hands resting at the edge of a basin with mist rising from it.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾到低温液体，这样处理：
overlay: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 常温水冲手，计时器显示15分钟
shots.prompt_en: A hand rinsed under room-temperature running water beside a blank timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用常温水冲受影响部位15分钟。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 热水壶和冰块图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A steaming kettle icon and an ice cube icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用很热或很冷的水。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 湿润双手摊开，沙漏旁标60分钟
shots.prompt_en: Wet hands held open beside an hourglass icon, the skin slowly regaining color.
shots.narration: 复温要慢，可能要长达60分钟。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦冻伤，立即就医。

shots.scene: 小研熟练地按步骤操作，阿杰戴好手套在旁学习
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully step by step at a dewar while the young male student, now in gloves, watches and learns.
shots.narration: 熟悉低温液体、时刻小心，最能防伤。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现雪花、粘手、飞溅、冰堵、火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a snowflake, a stuck hand, a splash, an ice plug and a flame.
shots.narration: 冻伤、粘皮、飞溅、冻堵、助燃。

shots.scene: 排风扇、报警器、杜瓦瓶、两人推罐图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exhaust fan, an oxygen alarm, a dewar with a loose lid and two people moving a tank. No people.
shots.narration: 通风报警，杜瓦松盖，两人搬运。

shots.scene: 宽松手套、面罩、皮鞋、常温水图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of loose cryogenic gloves, a face shield, leather shoes and a running tap. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴防护，沾到皮肤常温水慢慢冲。

shots.scene: 欣欣在低温容器旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a cryogenic dewar with a loose lid.
shots.narration: 小心低温，安全实验，下次见！
